validity_notes: C4 (B_UNFIXED_PROTOCOL_ONLY) fails as a test design issue: the frozen URL pair (https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/ + /about) produces a common prefix that Fix2 passes but Fix3 also passes because the prefix contains '/' in the rest. The C4 condition is therefore untestable with the current Fix2+Fix3 combination — Fix2 subsumes Fix3 for the tested URL pattern.

unresolved: Fix3 necessity is not demonstrated by B_UNFIXED_PROTOCOL_ONLY for the tested URL pair.
